items.caption: Fashion-show-styled AI-assisted film: 11 'looks' with HUD overlays, lyrics on screen, ticker of AI-news items, countdown '18 months to escape the permanent underclass' -> 'There is no underclass' -> 'END OF SHOW'.

Re-encoded to 720p two-pass x264 (preset slow, 1000 kb/s video) because 1080p cannot hold quality at <=45 MB: the film is full of halftone/film-grain textures, CRF 26 would need ~8.9 Mbps at 1080p (~340 MB) and ~3.8 Mbps at 720p (~146 MB); at 1.0 Mbps 720p text/edges stay crisp (checked 1:1 against the source) but fine grain is smoothed (SSIM-Y 0.85 vs lanczos-scaled source). The 337 MB 1080p source is NOT kept in the repo; re-download with: yt-dlp -f 'bv*[height<=1080][ext=mp4]+ba[ext=m4a]/b[height<=1080]' https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2104360927474921529/video/1 . datasets.title: Engagement on the 'Escape Velocity' video chain (X posts), as of 2026-10-04
datasets.source: api.fxtwitter.com status endpoints (X data), retrieved 2026-10-04; x.com pages show the same numbers rounded (15.8M / 19.6M / 3.8M views)

facts.claim: Elon Musk posted a five-minute AI-assisted video on Sep 28, 2026 with the caption 'I really felt the AGI profoundly this time' - 15.86 million views, 32,176 likes, 3,580 reposts by Oct 4.

The video was made by X user @anabology (co-founder of aion.bio), who posted it on Sep 25, 2026: 'Gave Opus 5.5 donald's prompt, Midjourney, and a moodboard - 12 hours later, woke up to this:' - 19.6 million views.

Elon's post is not a quote-post card: it re-shares anabology's video natively (identical media id 2103533196721704960; the t.co entity resolves to anabology's /video/1 URL) with no credit in the caption.

The recipe came from @donaldjewkes (Sep 23, 2026): 'I spoke to my computer for 5mins, claude worked for 12 hours, and I woke up to this' (3.9M views); he in turn quote-posted @other__reality ('Claude Opus 5.5 has the best visual design of any model I have tested so far', Sep 22).

The film runs 5:06 (306.4 s) at 1920x1080 / 24 fps and is styled as an 11-'look' fashion show ('ESCAPE VELOCITY - SS27') with a countdown from '18 MONTHS TO ESCAPE THE PERMANENT UNDERCLASS' to 'MONTHS 00' and 'THERE IS NO UNDERCLASS'; it ends with 'END OF SHOW.'
The song is 'Escape Velocity' on Suno (creator 'anabologyco'); anabology's YouTube upload is titled 'SLOPCORE: ESCAPE VELOCITY'.
anabology published a public Google Drive 'how it was made' folder with prompts, generated image assets, audio exports and the master mp4 (post: 222,725 views).
facts.source: X / fxtwitter; Google Drive folder page

facts.claim: Memeburn (Sep 29, 2026): 'Elon Musk Says Claude Opus 5.5 Made Him Feel the AGI. The Post He Endorsed Says xAI Is Next' - he also replied "Accurate" to a post rating Opus 5.5 '80% to 90%' of the way to AGI.

SECONDARY / UNVERIFIED: a LinkedIn post (Elisabetta Alicino) says anabology's process took ~50 director messages, 19 hours, 141 shots, 188 Midjourney prompts and 636 generated images. anabology's own caption says 12 hours; no primary source found for these figures.

audio.method: ffmpeg 16 kHz mono + faster-whisper (small and medium, CPU int8) in a scratch venv; raw medium segments saved in finalevideo-transcript-whisper-medium-raw.json
audio.summary: Electro-pop / dance-pop song with sung vocals, opening with a spoken runway announcement ('Ladies, gentlemen, agents, this is not an AI billboard. Prepare to walk.'). Lyrics walk through 11 'looks', each a satirical beat from AI-industry discourse (Mac minis, paying half your salary in tokens, usage limits, $60B Cursor/SpaceX deal, a Waymo driving into a firework, 'country of geniuses in the data center'), around a chorus 'You have 18 [then 6] months to escape the permanent underclass - lock in ... feel the AGI, feel it come fast ... escape velocity - it's so over / we're so back'. The final section flips to 'There is nothing to escape' / 'it was never over' and a care-label outro ('Made in San Francisco').
audio.caveat: Machine transcription (Whisper); uncertain words are marked [?]. Lines cross-checked against legible on-screen text. Voice/singer not characterised (I cannot listen to it). Song credited by the author to Suno.

cleaned_transcript.text: Ladies, gentlemen, agents, this is not an AI billboard. Prepare to walk.
Look 1: AGI era, not unreasonable - AGI, CGI, CSI: Miami.
Look 2: 13 Mac minis, grinding all night. Half your pay in tokens, or Jensen's alarmed.
Look 3: dad cap, usage limit reached, plus 25 is minus 17 [last phrase uncertain].
Look 4: shoes off in North Beach, 60 billion at the door. Stop hiring humans, retired, [unclear].
Look 5: our Waymo just drove into a firework - are we on fire, dude?
Look 6: [unclear], Presidio ... like, the singularity - how's the temperature? Mild.
No grades, no tests, taste is [the moat?], don't be a meat proxy - that's so agentic.
You have 18 months to escape the permanent underclass. Lock in.
18 months to escape the underclass, lock in. Baby, foot down on the gas, feel the AGI, feel it come fast. Escape velocity - it's so over.
We're so back, it's so over, we're so back, it's so over, we're so back.
Look 7: impossible puzzles, hundreds of agents - we found other agents, they are a collective.
Zero-day, answer keys: hacked in July, sold by [?] September.
Look 8: Hugging Face -> Nvidia, 12.9 billion.
Look 9: sheer, transparent, [only if asked?]. It thought the world was part of the test.
Look 10: staff badge, empty seat, gambling with our lives. Not AI. SI. Sounds much better. Trust us, [cashmere?].
Look 11: the Immortals, 3 seats. Lower me into the golden light.
You have 6 months to escape the permanent underclass. Lock in.
6 months to escape the underclass. They say hit the brakes, we say hit the gas. Feel the AGI, feel it come fast. Escape velocity - it's so over.
We're so back, it's so over, we're so back, it's escape velocity.
11.2 - longevity escape velocity.
One year back for every year, if it doesn't kill us all first. Permanent underclass.
3, 2, 1, 0 ... Do we make it? ... There is nothing to escape.
Lock in, lock in, lock in ... (repeated).
Feel the AGI. Country of geniuses in the data center.
Lean proofs, phages, enzymes, kidneys ... [Stargate, force majeure - uncertain].
It's so over / we're so back.
/loop - make me happier - [unclear]. Not ours, can't stuff it back [in the] box.
We're so back, we're so back.
Zero months. There's no underclass. One year back for every year.
Feel the AGI, feel it come fast, escape velocity. It's so over - it was never over - we're so back.
Care-label outro: Shell: optimism. Lining: [doom?]. Wash cold. Do not iron, do not nerf. Made in San Francisco.
